university.name: R.V Institute of Technology and Management (RVITM)
university.motto: Excellence in Technical Education & Global Innovation
university.accreditation: Approved by AICTE, New Delhi & Affiliated to Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi
university.location: Chaithanya Layout, 8th Phase, J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560076, India

key_stats.partner_universities: Global Co-ops & Tech Industry Centers of Excellence

programs.name: B.E. in Computer Science & Engineering
programs.annual_tuition: KCET Govt: ₹98,000 / COMEDK: ₹2,64,000 / Mgmt Quota Available
programs.overview: Flagship engineering program covering Advanced Computing, Cloud Architecture, Distributed Systems, Full-Stack Development, and Algorithmic Intelligence with RV industry incubation.
programs.eligibility: 10+2 / Pre-University (PUC) with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with Chemistry/Bio-Tech/CS. Minimum 50% marks in aggregate. KCET, COMEDK, or Management Entrance.

programs.name: B.E. in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
programs.annual_tuition: KCET Govt: ₹98,000 / COMEDK: ₹2,64,000 / Mgmt Quota Available
programs.overview: Rigorous specialization in Deep Learning, Generative AI, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and Predictive Analytics in modern GPU labs.
programs.eligibility: 10+2 / 12th standard with Physics & Mathematics. Minimum 50% aggregate score (45% for reserved categories). KCET / COMEDK rank.

programs.name: B.E. in Information Science & Engineering
programs.annual_tuition: KCET Govt: ₹98,000 / COMEDK: ₹2,64,000 / Mgmt Quota Available
programs.overview: Focuses on Software Engineering, Information Security, Data Structures, Networking Systems, Big Data Analytics, and Web Technologies.
programs.eligibility: 10+2 / PUC with Physics and Mathematics as core subjects. Minimum 50% aggregate.

programs.name: B.E. in Electronics & Communication Engineering
programs.annual_tuition: KCET Govt: ₹98,000 / COMEDK: ₹2,35,000 / Mgmt Quota Available
programs.overview: Comprehensive curriculum spanning VLSI Design, Embedded Systems, IoT, Digital Signal Processing, RF Communication, and Robotics.
programs.eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Electronics. Minimum 50% aggregate.

programs.name: M.Tech in Advanced Computer Science & Engineering
programs.overview: Research-oriented post-graduate program emphasizing Distributed Computing, Cybersecurity, and Scalable Architectures with industry sponsored capstone projects.
programs.eligibility: B.E. / B.Tech in CSE / ISE / IT / ECE with minimum 50% marks (45% for reserved category). Valid GATE / Karnataka PGCET score.

application_steps: Step 1: Provide your Email ID & basic details via the Online Admission Enquiry Form or AI Assistant.
Step 2: Submit 10th and 12th / PUC marks cards along with your KCET / COMEDK / JEE scorecard.
Step 3: Attend counseling and merit seat evaluation with the RVITM Admissions Board at the JP Nagar campus or virtually.
Step 4: Receive your Provisional Seat Allotment Letter and complete fee remittance.
Step 5: Report to the campus for document verification and commencement of the academic semester.
documents_required: 10th Standard / SSLC Marks Card (Proof of Date of Birth)
Transfer Certificate (TC) & Migration Certificate (if outside Karnataka)
Study Certificate & Caste / Income Certificate (if claiming reservation quota)
Recent Passport Size Photographs (6 copies) & Govt ID Proof (Aadhaar / Passport)

scholarships.name: RSST Merit Academic Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Students scoring 95%+ in 10+2 / PUC or holding top 1,000 ranks in KCET / COMEDK.
scholarships.perks: Mentorship by senior research faculty and priority industry co-op placement.

scholarships.name: Girls in Engineering (STEM) Grant
scholarships.eligibility: Meritorious female engineering applicants enrolling in CSE, AI & ML, and ISE.
scholarships.perks: Access to RV Women in Technology leadership conclaves.

scholarships.name: Sports & National Talent Laureate Award
scholarships.eligibility: National or State level medal winners in sports, robotics olympiads, or hackathons.
scholarships.perks: Subsidized campus athletic training and flexible academic scheduling.

scholarships.name: Government Social Welfare & Fee Reimbursement
scholarships.coverage: Full / Partial Reimbursement via State Portals
scholarships.eligibility: Eligible SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates as per Karnataka State Government norms.
scholarships.perks: Facilitated through dedicated RVITM Scholarship Desk.

campus_life.accommodation: Separate well-furnished hostels for boys and girls with 24/7 high-speed Wi-Fi, CCTV security, biometric access, hygienic food, and power backup.
campus_life.dining: Multi-cuisine hygienic campus cafeteria and student mess serving balanced vegetarian and nutritional meals.
campus_life.sports_recreation: Indoor sports complex, badminton courts, gymnasium, table tennis, basketball court, and outdoor turf facilities.
campus_life.clubs: Active student bodies including IEEE Student Branch, Google Developer Groups on Campus, Coding Club, Robotics & IoT Club, Rotaract, and Cultural Fests.
